_doc.source: DESIGN.md §6.3 — pinned expectations for services/batches.interleave and spread_similar (WP4); consumed by tests/unit/test_batches.py
_doc.interleave: if either list is empty return the other unchanged; else k = ceil(len(reviews)/len(news)); emit k reviews then 1 new, repeat; when one list runs out append the rest of the other in order. Items are opaque tokens here (R1..Rn reviews, N1..Nm news).
_doc.spread_similar: single stable left-to-right pass over positions i = 0..n-1 of the CURRENT sequence; two items are similar when both lemmas have >= 4 letters and share their first 4 letters; if item i is similar to any item at i-3..i-1, remove it and insert it at the first later index j > i (index in the resulting sequence, j <= n-1) where none of the items at j-3..j-1 is similar to it (the items in between shift one place left); if no such j exists the item stays; the pass then continues with position i+1 (no re-examination of the item shifted into position i). Inputs below are lemma strings; apply the function with a lemma key for real items.

interleave.note: k=1: RNRN then the remaining news

spread_similar.note: abandoned leaves the 3-window of abandon → lands at index 4 (≥ 3 apart)
two similarity families (base/bases, basis/basic); bank/band are not similar (first 4 letters differ)
no later position is free → items stay where they are
lemmas shorter than 4 letters are never similar; goal/goat differ in the 4th letter
rece* family spread across the sequence
absorb (index 2) is similar to absolute (index 0) and moves to the first free slot; absurd/abstract/absence share only 3 letters with it and are not similar
